channel.title: MeritHyre Blog
channel.description: Practical guides on AI recruiting, structured interviews, compliance and staffing workflows from the MeritHyre team.

item.title: Time-to-Hire vs Quality-of-Hire: Which Metric Should You Actually Track?
item.description: Fast hires are easy; good hires are the ones you can measure. Learn what time-to-hire and quality-of-hire each tell you, where each one misleads, and how to track both.

item.title: Candidate Fraud in Hiring: Spot Fake Profiles and Proxies
item.description: The resume looks sharp and the answers sound polished, yet weeks after the offer the work doesn’t match. Here’s how to spot fake profiles and proxy interviews early.

item.title: AI Resume Screening vs Keyword Matching: Which Wins?
item.description: A single job posting can draw hundreds of applications, and software decides which ones get a human look. Compare keyword matching with AI resume screening.

item.title: How to Write Job Descriptions That AI Can Screen Against
item.description: AI screening reads your job description before it reads a single resume, so a messy JD means messy scores. Use this framework to write JDs that AI can screen against.

item.title: Who Owns Candidate Data in AI Recruiting? Contract Clauses to Check
item.description: Whoever negotiates the data clauses controls candidate data, and in most AI hiring deals nobody negotiates them. Here are the contract clauses to check before you sign.

item.title: Structured Interview Scorecards: Templates and Best Practices Guide
item.description: Most hiring teams already run interviews, but far fewer can explain why one candidate scored higher than another. Structured scorecards turn gut feel into defensible decisions.

item.title: AI Recruitment Automation The Complete Guide to Fixing Hiring Bottlenecks
item.description: Application volume keeps climbing while the hours in a recruiter’s day stay fixed. This guide shows where hiring slows down and how AI-native automation removes the bottlenecks.

item.title: NYC Local Law 144 Compliance Checklist for AI Hiring Tools (2026)
item.description: Many hiring teams assume their software vendor handles NYC Local Law 144. It doesn’t: the bias audit, public summary and candidate notice are the employer’s job.

item.title: AI-Native vs. Bolt-On AI Recruiting: What’s Actually Different?
item.description: One vendor says AI-powered, another says AI-native, and both promise faster screening and smarter shortlists. Here’s what actually separates them, and why it matters.

item.title: From Job Order to Ranked Shortlist: The AI-Native Staffing Workflow US Agencies Are Adopting
item.description: A job order comes in, the clock starts, and a recruiter opens fifteen tabs at once. Here’s the AI-native workflow US staffing agencies are adopting to reach a ranked shortlist.

item.title: Every recruiter has felt it: You fill the role, and three months later you’re starting the exact same search from zero.
item.description: The req closes, the offer goes out, and eleven weeks later the same role is back on your desk with no memory of the last search. Here’s why, and what a hiring loop changes.

item.title: Why AI-Native Beats AI-Powered: The Architecture Difference That Changes Everything
item.description: Most recruitment tools claim to be AI-powered. But adding AI features to existing software is very different from building a platform where AI is the operating model.
